# Get started

Follow these steps to set up the demo.

## Setup

Prepare the workspace before you install anything.

### Install

Run the command below, then check the output.

| Step | Command |
| ---- | ------- |
| One  | `composer install` |
| Two  | `php bin/demo` |

```sh
composer install
```

See [the overview](../index.md#top-heading) and [the example](https://example.com/) for more.
